purpose: ring-neuron dopamine stage 2b: clamp the ring threshold term to its dark reference and cross that with the CX_DAN fast disconnect

dark_reference.note: d_v = -dV_D1*r1*occ1 + dV_D2*r2*occ2 at da = DA_ref; the clamp uses this constant, not zero and not the base threshold

probe.purpose: ring-neuron dopamine stage 2b: the two-by-two of CX_DAN fast synapses present or absent crossed with the ER threshold term dynamic or clamped to its dark reference. Per cell, never a population mean. A null is a result.

protocol.clamp_definition: InstrumentedNeuromod.receptor_terms replaces d_v on the 228 traced ER cells with the constant dark reference; the dopamine pool, innervation, source term, occupancies and the input gain are untouched
protocol.disconnect_definition: Neuromod.apply_genotype with dan_fast_synapses='disconnect' zeroes every recurrent synapse whose presynaptic cell is in DAN or CX_DAN; it does not silence those cells, change their extended input rates, or change the innervation matrix or kinetics

dark_reference_check.unit: dark arm natural ER d_v over the 18 s window, per seed, in mV
dark_reference_check.note: stage 1 recorded a 5e-6 uM stray-spike transient on two dark seeds; the clamp uses the constant dark reference and this is the size of the departure

clamp_audit.purpose: stage 2b clamp audit and the reused stage 2 disconnect audit

reference.note: d_v = -dV_D1*r1*occ1 + dV_D2*r2*occ2 at da = DA_ref; the clamp uses this constant, not zero and not the base threshold

clamp.purpose: prove the ER d_v clamp replaces only the threshold term and survives a pool step

disconnect.purpose: verify the dan_fast_synapses disconnect layer removes only DAN/CX_DAN fast synapses

retain_modulation.unit: paired difference is left minus right over the ten seeds; interval is mean +/- 1.96 SE

disconnect_modulation.unit: paired difference is left minus right over the ten seeds; interval is mean +/- 1.96 SE

interaction.unit: per seed, (driven-retain minus driven-retain-clamped) minus (driven-disconnect minus driven-disconnect-clamped); interval is mean +/- 1.96 SE

resolution.unit: smallest spike effect this design could resolve from the measured standard error; 1.96 SE is the project's interval convention and 2.262 SE is the paired-t multiplier at n=10. Neither is a pass line.

disconnect_audit.purpose: verify the dan_fast_synapses disconnect layer removes only DAN/CX_DAN fast synapses

limitation: This is a threshold-modulation test, not an all-dopamine test. The clamp replaces only the ER threshold term d_v; the dopamine pool, innervation, source activity, the occ1/occ2 calculation and the receptor input gain all stay live, so any dopamine effect that does not act through d_v is still present in the clamped arms. The probe injects at TuBu, downstream of a visual pathway that does not conduct: the fly does not see. A clamped arm is not the same condition as the dark arm, which removes source activation and leaves EB dopamine at its fixed point rather than driving it.
reading_note: An interval that includes zero is no detected difference, not equivalence, and an interval containing zero does not establish additivity. Neither the interaction interval nor its resolution is a pass line (item 121). Both arms carry the stripe, so a firing cell is an active cell, not a demonstrated stripe response.
fraction_note: Each fraction is the mean of the ten per-seed ratios, the same statistic stage 2 used for its survival fraction: (R1-R0)/(R1-dark) gives 0.361917 [0.3335, 0.3904] and (D1-D0)/(D1-dark) gives 0.375924 [0.3542, 0.3977]. The ratio of the paired means is a different number, 561.3/1550.4 = 0.362036 retained and 551.2/1465.7 = 0.376066 disconnected. Neither fraction is a pass line or a criterion (item 121).
control_sign_note: The disconnect layer zeroes all 70,134 DAN+CX_DAN outgoing edges. The 62,215 non-CX_DAN DAN edges are net excitatory in the engine's composed weights: 60,902 are curated excitatory (mod, +27475.525 mV) and 1,313 are curated inhibitory (GABA, -559.9 mV), a net of +26915.625 mV, and all 213 DAN/CX_DAN edges onto a traced ER are excitatory (+105.05 mV). Removing a net-excitatory dark input lowers the driven-disconnect arm, so the +1465.7 retained-minus-dark contrast is conservative rather than inflated. The raw connection-file sign is excitatory on all 62,215 edges; the curated scale makes 1,313 of them inhibitory in the composed weight, so the direction rests on the net, which is excitatory.
